title: Death of Chris Kelly and playing Sam Morgan's funeral
summary: Howard learned of Chris's death on return from tour and played Sam Morgan's funeral with a get-together band.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: That's something I couldn't tell you. Was it somebody after? Chris died after Buddy, I think. Because I was with Morgan Band, and I left Morgan Band in Greenwood, Mississippi. And when we got into the station, to the bus station that morning, that's when we knew Chris had died. They had buried him the day before we got in. He must have been here one day.
Was Sam Morgan dead then or not?
Yes, Sam was dead. I was playing with young Morgan.
So he died after Sam then? Yeah.
I'm sure he died after Sam. I know I was out there with the band. I'm sure Sam was sick. I played Sam's film myself. You did?
You got together a band there?
Yeah. For Sam. And they had a big mistake. They had to correct it. They said I was ill played, but it wasn't I was ill, it was me. You see? I played for Sam.
